_comment: The harness size budget (Round 3 / W7, ADR-H288). The TOTAL is the binding constraint; the per-module ratchet lives in python/tests/test_size_budget.py. Raising a ceiling is allowed but must be a deliberate edit to this file - the point is that growth cannot happen silently. Re-pinned on 2026-11-05 to the measured tree after Phase 22 / S1 (project memory), S2 (build sessions), S3 (maintenance), S4 (land pipeline) and S6 (the self-build scorecard + landing markers). Re-pinned again the same day for the deterministic quant protocol (`python/harness/quant_intent.py`, a new capability; graph.py itself stayed at its ratchet). Re-pinned again for the composer's Choices mode (`python/harness/choices_mode.py`, a new prompt-block module + the graph.py seam). Re-pinned on 2026-11-06 to the measured tree after the Builds tab (`code/session.py::budget_for_autonomy` + the `AgenticService.run`/`run_background` seam); the same measurement includes the in-flight quant-intent guard and composer plan-mode work already present in the tree, so re-check this file when those land. The unified model catalog (`python/harness/model_catalog.py`) is included. These ceilings are the measured values, not padding; the ratchet resumes from here.
